title: AMA Agent Audit Entry
description: Immutable record of one agent invocation, emitted by the centralised middleware. Backs FR-014, FR-015, FR-020. Stored in the existing audit_entries Cosmos container under the existing 7-year online retention policy (FR-012a, deny-delete role + Azure Policy initiative). NOTE on HITL approver identity: this schema deliberately does NOT carry an `approver_identity` field. For HITL approval events, approver identity (per spec 008) is recorded in the `approval_decisions` Cosmos container and correlated to this audit entry via the workflow run's `pending_request_id` / the wrapped MAF `RequestInfoEvent.request_id`. See contracts/hitl-request.envelope.md.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonicalised input JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace). MUST NOT be the raw input (NN-3 privacy by design).

output_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonicalised output JSON, when produced. Null when the invocation failed before producing an output.

correlation_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace_id linking this audit entry to its span (FR-016).

outcome.description: Categorical outcome; version_mismatch is set when an MCP tool's advertised major version did not match the allow-list (FR-019a).

tool_invocations.description: Captured when the agent step called one or more MCP tools (FR-020).
